dish.n: Members' lawn cold lamb and mint sandwiches
dish.note: Thin-sliced cold roast lamb, mint sauce and butter in soft white bread, crusts off.
dish.how: Rub 500g lamb backstrap with oil, salt and pepper, sear 3 minutes a side in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 10 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and chill. Butter 8 slices of soft white bread, spread 4 slices with 3 tbsp mint sauce, top with the thinly sliced lamb, a handful of mint leaves and the other bread. Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

steps.text: Rub the lamb with oil, salt and pepper and sear in a hot pan.
Roast at 200C, then rest and chill.
Butter the bread, spread half with mint sauce and layer the thinly sliced lamb and mint.
Top with the remaining bread, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

dish.make_ahead: Roast the lamb the day before; make the sandwiches up to 3 hours ahead under a damp cloth

veg.n: Members' lawn minted pea and feta sandwiches (vegetarian)

steps.text: Simmer the peas for 3 minutes, drain and cool.
Mash the peas with the feta, lemon juice, chopped mint, salt and pepper.
Butter the bread and spread half with the pea mash.
Top with the remaining bread, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sandwiches up to 3 hours ahead under a damp cloth

dish.vegNote: Minted pea and feta in place of the lamb
